messages:
leo_ml: quick note: onboarding run for orion48k-int4 produced recurring "ghost" tokens after long proper-noun spans when using stride-bucket prefill + sparse-compact. short repro below.
maya_infra: can you paste serve flags + image? also which cluster?
leo_ml: serve: `./serve --model orion48k-int4 --prefill=stride-bucket --prefill-stride=4 --kv=sparse-compact --quant=int4_perch --compress-meta=true` image: gh/onboard/orion-int4:try-19 cluster: ded-3
nina_eval: sample mismatch (fp16 vs int4):
```
FP16: "On June 12th, Dr. Helena Kovacs announced the new protocol..."
INT4: "On June 12th Dr. Helena Kovacs announced new protocol..."
```
leak pattern: dropped comma and occasional duplicate token near long titles. perplexity on small goldset: fp16=7.2 int4=11.4
oliver_research: early suspect: when stride>1 sparse-compact reorders tiled shards and we might be applying RoPE multipliers using the original linear index rather than the compacted slot index. run `kv-index-check --mode compare --seed 1337` on both runs.
leo_ml: ran kv-index-check, excerpt:
```
fp16 index[1024]=0x1f3a...
int4(compact) index[1024]=0x1f3a...
int4(compact) index[1025]=0x2b4c...  <-- expected 0x2b4c but mapping shows shift at tile boundaries
```
maya_infra: ci-bot: can we push a canary with sparse-compact disabled for this image? ci-bot: build 18999 pushed, canary deploy scheduled :ok_hand:
nina_eval: also ran `rope-phase-diff --fp fp16 --quant int4 --window 20000` -> max phase delta 0.0028 at pos 18720, which aligns with error start.
oliver_research: mitigation: set `--prefill-stride=1` or disable sparse-compact; longer term: ensure compact path remaps positional multipliers after compaction. add unit test for compact->logical_index mapping with stride>1.
leo_ml: will run v1 prefill + deterministic seed and re-run goldset. if numbers improve, open revert PR and include mapping unit test.
maya_infra: thumbs up. please paste results here once done.
